mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 2.5% compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy supports risk-taking.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 2.5% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 3.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and reduces valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.0% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE < 3.5%) with accelerating job growth (PAYEMS increase > 100k), corporate hiring supports earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE is below 3.5% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates strong labor market conditions that sustain consumer spending and corporate profit growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 108.0 signals weakening economic activity, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO falls below 108.0 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of strong housing market growth (HOUST > 1250k) and robust GDP expansion (GDPC1 > 2.0% annualized), elevated consumer demand drives corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where HOUST exceeds 1250.0 and GDPC1 growth is above 2.0%, S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) combined with elevated interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%) signals inflationary pressures that prompt rate hikes, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of CPIAUCSL above 2.5% and FEDFUNDS above 2.5% fails to predict negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).
